entities.summary: Toshio Mashima was a heads of state & government in Tsuruoka (1949, Tsuruoka – 2016-04-21) who made significant contributions during the Contemporary era. Their work intersected with political systems and governance and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Influenced national policy and international relations.
